_provenance: M9 ephaptic GEOMETRY atlas (v1.18). A MEASURED 3D position [L] in MNI152 stereotaxic space (mm) for each of the twelve M9 central-brain organs, so the ephaptic coupling kernel can be evaluated on REAL inter-region distances instead of the equal-spacing [O] ring of the frozen v1.17 engine. Coordinates are COPIED from published atlases/papers (DB-SOURCED; we do NOT pick geometry to move the result), exactly as the gamma layer locks NCBI-derived values. Composite organs (neocortex/striatum/cerebellum/bilateral merges) are VOLUME-WEIGHTED centroids of AAL centers-of-mass (Tzourio-Mazoyer 2002). Per-region coord_grade is honest: [L] = exact published atlas center-of-mass or single-structure MNI centroid; [O] = representative literature-consistent point for an elongated or open/distributed structure with no single canonical MNI centroid (midbrain, brainstem, basal-forebrain cholinergic, distributed forebrain GABAergic interneurons). No measurement is invented. The engine reads NOTHING from this file; only the v1.18 decision-check module (geometry_grounding.py) reads it, as a locked data input.
_kernel: 1/r^3 near-field locality is UNCHANGED (neuro 18 [V]); v1.18 changes ONLY the positions ([O] ring -> [L] measured MNI), not the coupling form.
_grading: MNI coordinate [L measured input] where an exact atlas CoM / published centroid exists; [O representative] for elongated/open/distributed structures with no single canonical centroid. ephaptic kappa stays the MEASURED fraction (neuro 19); normalization is a declared [F] choice (see geometry_grounding.py docstring).

_sources.AAL: Tzourio-Mazoyer et al. 2002, NeuroImage 15:273-289; centers-of-mass (MNI) per figshare 184981 / Frontiers SOM Table S1 (article 503556).
_sources.hypothalamus: Ogawa et al. 2024, PMC11487351 (stereotaxic MNI coordinates of human hypothalamic nuclei).
_sources.basal_forebrain: Zaborszky et al. 2008, NeuroImage 42:1127-1141 (cytoarchitectonic probabilistic BF Ch1-Ch4 maps); Mesulam Ch4 = nucleus basalis.
_sources.midbrain: Bianciardi et al. 2015, Brain Struct Funct 220:2387-2405; Rolls et al. 2020 AAL3 midbrain nuclei.
_sources.brainstem: Harvard-Oxford Brain-Stem (FSL); Paxinos & Huang 1995 human brainstem atlas; PHOX2B preBotzinger respiratory column (Smith 1991).

_relation_to_v117: ADD-ONLY. The frozen v1.17 engine (tree_sha256 b18c86268679b3e19e495b7161fd3a5035605481c8ea76736a84accd0ef26ae7, 95 regression checks) is UNCHANGED and reads nothing from this file. v1.18 adds this atlas + a decision-check module that imports the engine read-only. Promoting the engine's default M9 from ring to measured geometry (with cascade analysis) and decomposing nodes to capture sulcal-bank folding are the explicit v1.19 entry points.

neocortex.coord_source: AAL (Tzourio-Mazoyer 2002) volume-weighted centroid of 74 isocortical parcels
neocortex.note: Whole cortical mantle centroid; excludes allocortex (hippocampus) and subcortical nuclei.

hypothalamus.coord_source: Ogawa et al. 2024 (PMC11487351) human hypothalamic-nuclei MNI centroids (medial nuclei; MPO ~(-1.5,2.3,-12.8))
hypothalamus.note: Representative whole-hypothalamus point; medial nuclei cluster near x~0, z~-12.

midbrain.note: Mesencephalon is an elongated structure with no single canonical MNI centroid -> [O] on purpose.

brainstem.coord_source: lower brainstem pons/medulla; PHOX2B preBotzinger/visceral-motor column, rostral ventrolateral medulla (Harvard-Oxford Brain-Stem / Paxinos-Huang family)
brainstem.note: Brainstem is elongated with no single canonical MNI centroid -> [O] on purpose.

forebrain_gaba_in.coord_source: distributed pan-forebrain GABAergic interneurons (MGE/CGE-derived; Cardin 2009, Sohal 2009); representative = AAL telencephalon volume-weighted centroid
forebrain_gaba_in.note: No single locus: PV/SST interneurons are spread throughout cortex+striatum -> [O] on purpose. Telencephalic center used as representative.

basal_forebrain_chol.coord_source: Zaborszky et al. 2008 (NeuroImage 42:1127) cytoarchitectonic BF Ch4 probabilistic maps; Mesulam Ch4 = nucleus basalis (substantia innominata, sublenticular)
basal_forebrain_chol.note: nucleus basalis is an 'open' structure without strict boundaries (Mesulam) -> [O] on purpose. Bilateral-merged sublenticular point.

olfactory_bulb.coord_source: AAL Olfactory_L/_R centers-of-mass, volume-weighted (PROXY: AAL 'Olfactory' = olfactory region/sulcus, not the bulb proper)
olfactory_bulb.note: AAL has no olfactory-bulb parcel; the bulb proper sits ~10-15 mm anterior. Exact AAL CoM, proxy structure.
